documentation.content:
The API is failing requests. Check the Cloud Run logs for the service, filtered to severity>=ERROR, and look for a correlationId to tie a user report to a stack.

If the readiness endpoint reports poolStarved, the cause is transactions holding connections: see docs/operations.md.

Rollback: gcloud run services update-traffic truck-tracker-api --project windies-app --region us-central1 --to-revisions <previous>=100

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "truck-tracker-api" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx"
